author: A skald of Windhelm
pages:
~Over the chasm the old bones lie,
~white as the frost on the river reed,
~and the mist below is a sea of sighs
~where the cowards fall and the faithful lead.

~Tsun stands at the near end, broad as a door,
~and asks every soul what it did with its days.
~Some answer with deeds, and he lets them pass;
~some answer with boasts, and he shows them the ways.

~Beyond is the Hall where the long fires burn,
~where Ysgramor drinks with his five hundred kin.
~Live so the old giant steps aside,
~and the doors of the Hall will let you in.
